summary: TryHard Holdings Ltd filed Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification confirming compliance with the minimum bid price rule. The company had been non-compliant since March 2026 and executed a 10-for-1 reverse stock split effective August 10, 2026, which raised the share price above $1.00. Nasdaq confirmed compliance on August 28, 2026, based on 10 consecutive business days of closing bid prices at or above $1.00. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms apply. What to watch: continued ability to maintain the minimum bid price going forward.
